title: Partial Kummer description of the inner-boundary unit after outer direct image
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extended norm topology. Fix a finite intermediate field $\mathbf Q_\ell\subseteq E\subseteq\Omega$. For $F=E$ or $\Omega$, let $C_F(S)=C(S,F)$ on profinite sets, using all continuous maps [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]; put $C_{F,T}=p_T^*C_F$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use internal modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] and their ordinary unbounded derived categories and direct images [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull].

Let $Y$ be a regular separated finite-type $k$-scheme [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-weil-regular-scheme], let $D=\bigcup_{a\in A}D_a$ be a reduced strict normal crossings divisor with finitely many components [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary], and put $W=Y\setminus D$. Let $L$ be a finite-rank lisse $C_{E,W}$-module [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module]. Assume that on every strict henselization at a geometric point, with parameters $t_1,\ldots,t_r$ cutting out the branches of $D$, $L$ becomes constant on the inverse-limit cover of the complement obtained by adjoining compatible $n$th roots of all $t_i$ for every $n$ prime to $p$. This is the meaning of tame here; with no branches the cover is the identity. Write $L_F=C_{F,W}\otimes_{C_{E,W}}L$, an ordinary tensor, for $F=E,\Omega$.

Partition $A=A_o\sqcup A_i$. Put $V=Y\setminus\bigcup_{a\in A_o}D_a$, $j:V\hookrightarrow Y$, $b:W\hookrightarrow V$, and let $h:Z_V\hookrightarrow V$ be the reduced closed complement of $W$ in $V$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]. All restrictions below are exact inverse images, with the coefficient identifications from pullback from the point. Put $K_F=Rb_{*,C_F}(L_F[0])$ and use the actual unit $\eta_{h,K_F}:K_F\to h_*h^*K_F$ of closed inverse/direct image [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed]. Define the arrow
$$u_F=Rj_*(\eta_{h,K_F}):Rj_*Rb_*L_F[0]\longrightarrow Rj_*h_*h^*Rb_*L_F[0].$$
For $J\subseteq A$ with $J_i=J\cap A_i\ne\varnothing$, let $J_o=J\cap A_o$ and let $S_J=(\bigcap_{a\in J}D_a)\setminus\bigcup_{a\notin J}D_a$ with its reduced locally closed structure and inclusion $s_J:S_J\to Y$. Put $G_o=(\prod_{q\ne p}\mathbf Z_q)^{J_o}$ and $G_i=(\prod_{q\ne p}\mathbf Z_q)^{J_i}$, where $q$ runs over primes and $\mathbf Z_q=\varprojlim_n\mathbf Z/q^n\mathbf Z$. There is a pro-etale covering family $v_\alpha:T_\alpha\to S_J$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with simultaneous choices for $F=E,\Omega$ of compatible roots of unity and finite-dimensional norm-topological $E$-representations $M_\alpha$ of $G_o\times G_i$, on which $(s_Jv_\alpha)^*u_F$ is identified with
$$p_{T_\alpha}^*\bigl(\theta_{M_{\alpha,F}}:R\Gamma_{G_o\times G_i}(M_{\alpha,F})\longrightarrow R\Gamma_{G_o}(R\Gamma_{G_i}^{G_o}(M_{\alpha,F}))\bigr).$$
Here $M_{\alpha,F}$ is the condensed module $S\mapsto C(S,F\otimes_E M_\alpha)$ with the finite-dimensional product norm topology. Equivariant module categories and inflation adjunctions are those of [lem-sfb-condensed-product-action-inflation]; $R\Gamma_{G_i}^{G_o}$ derives $G_i$-invariants while retaining the $G_o$-action. All right derived functors are the ordinary K-injective ones [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. The map $\theta$ is the right-derived composition comparison induced by $M^{G_o\times G_i}=(M^{G_i})^{G_o}$, equivalently the conjugate of composition of the exact inflation functors. The displayed identification specifies both objects and the arrow, not only the cohomology sheaves: the closed unit is sent to that comparison by the augmentation of the two partial Kummer nerves, adjoining inner roots first and outer roots second. It is natural in $L$ and under restriction of the covering family. No invertibility of $u_F$, no extension by zero, and no scalar-extension/direct-image commutation is part of this statement.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-kummer-source-coherent-descent] with this $J$. It gives one pro-etale family covering the entire stratum, roots and boundary representations for both fields, and the coherent source comparison $\alpha_F$. Reordering the coordinates gives $G_J=G_o\times G_i$. Its root-tower extension for $\Omega$ is the ordinary scalar extension of the $E$-extension. Thus the same source model and geometric data apply to both coefficient rings.

source.place: Paragraph (3); re-split assembly, common coherent source charts

proof.text: On each chart invert the outer parameters to obtain $V\times_YU_\alpha$. Its reduced complement of $W\times_YU_\alpha$ is the union of the inner branches. The supplied extension and its boundary module meet every hypothesis of [lem-sfb-kummer-supported-nerve-descent]. This identifies the target of the actual closed unit, after outer direct image, with the same full-bar totalization as the source, by $\sigma_F$, with $\sigma_F\circ(s_Jv_\alpha)^*u_F=\alpha_F$. Its torsor hypothesis is part of the chart data of step 1, and its $\alpha_F$ is that of step 1: both totalize, along the same Cech augmentation, the restriction-of-sections comparisons of [lem-sfb-root-tower-boundary-acyclicity] (here $q_{\alpha,n}=af_n$, $e_\alpha=s$), using $Rc_*=Rj_*Rb_*$. The comparisons are the actual slice restrictions of the original arrow; the coefficient rings are pulled back from the point. This is an equality of derived arrows on coherent resolutions, including the parametrized action faces.

source.place: Paragraph (3); re-split assembly, supported closed-unit descent

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-kummer-partial-nerve-naturality], first with the identity of $L$; steps 1-2 run on its chart family, as the source and supported nodes allow any supplied charts. Its two geometric partial nerves and their successive augmentations identify the full target bar with the iterated invariant object by $\gamma_F$. The composite with the full source bar is $p_{T_\alpha}^*\theta$, with the prescribed ordinary K-injective inflation-adjunction normalization. Combining with $\sigma_Fu_F=\alpha_F$ proves the required arrow identification. For an actual map $L\to L'$, the same node supplies a common refined family, extensions of that map and their equivariant boundary $E$-linear maps. The naturality clauses of the source and supported-descent nodes and of $\gamma_F$ make their composite natural in this actual map for both fields; their restriction clauses give covering compatibility. Unique extension isomorphisms make the comparisons independent of extension choices.

source.place: Paragraph (3); re-split assembly, successive augmentations and naturality

proof.text: If $S_J$ is empty, use the empty covering family and the assertion has no members to check. If $J_o=\varnothing$, the outer group is trivial and its bar and invariants are the identity; the construction reduces to the inner nerve. The hypotheses require $J_i\ne\varnothing$, so there is no unsupported claim about an empty inner closed complement. Rank zero gives zero modules and zero complexes throughout. These checks also cover partitions with an empty outer part, and no strata of the stipulated type occur if the whole divisor or inner part is empty.
